akh.text: Amonkhet is a plane Bolas corrupted long ago, killing every being old enough to walk and overtaking its gods, then engineering a world where inhabitants reach physical perfection before killing each other in the Trials, all to create an army of Eternals.
The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas and meets fierce resistance in the desert and the city, from undead in the sand and giant wurms to a curse that inverts life and death.
In the trials Gideon pledges himself to Oketra and defies Bontu's demand for a heart, while the afterlife promised to the worthy dead turns out to be transformation into Eternals.
When Bolas returns the Gatewatch is soundly defeated and scatters, with most of the gods dying and only Hazoret left.

hou.text: In the Hour of Devastation the promised gate to the afterlife opens on Amonkhet, and Bolas returns as the God-Pharaoh to claim his army of Eternals.
He declares that everything on the plane exists or perishes at his whim, that his work is complete and that Amonkhet has outlived its usefulness, and he easily defeats the Gatewatch.
Bontu reveals she secretly helped Bolas conquer the plane, but after she defeats Hazoret at his command, he betrays and strikes her down.
Hazoret leads the survivors of Naktamun into the desert, swearing to protect them as the God-Survivor, and Samut rallies them to fight for tomorrow.

dft.text: In the Aetherdrift race Amonkhet's sands become a track where the Champions of Amonkhet and other racers fight goblins, Endriders and Speed Demons.
Chandra's fireball sends the Speed Demons spinning into a dune, and an Omenpath opens at the end of the Amonkhet track, leading to Muraganda.
At an oasis a lion-masked god tells Chandra that Bolas could not kill the spirit of Amonkhet's gods.
The Champions of Amonkhet barely beat Winter to first place, a door drags him to Duskmourn, and Zahur wins the Aetherspark for the team.
